name: otp-input
title: OTP Input
description: A one-time code field with 4 to 8 slots, a traveling focus highlight, and characters that rise into place.

useCases: Entering numeric or alphanumeric verification, two-factor, and invite codes of 4 to 8 characters.
limitations: Single row of 4 to 8 slots. Edits happen at the end of the code; clicking a filled slot does not move the caret into it. Alphanumeric codes are uppercased.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, and theme colors. Supply a label. Controlled usage requires updating value in onValueChange. Reduced motion removes animation and keeps a static caret.

docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/otp-input.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
